attributes.name: FirstName
attributes.description: The first name of the interested person

attributes.name: LastName
attributes.description: The last name of the interested person

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the lead

attributes.name: AdditionalOccupants
attributes.description: The number of other potential occupants of the residency

attributes.name: AssignedUserId
attributes.description: The AppFolio Property Manager user responsible for the lead. Reference the Users endpoint for any necessary associations.

attributes.name: Bathrooms
attributes.description: The number of desired bathrooms

attributes.name: Bedrooms
attributes.description: The number of desired bedrooms

attributes.name: CreatedAt
attributes.description: The date the lead was created. The value must adhere to the ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ and the default time zone is Coordinated Universal Time (UTC).

attributes.name: CreditScore
attributes.description: The self-reported credit score of the interested party

attributes.name: DesiredMoveIn
attributes.description: The date the prospective resident desires to move in

attributes.name: Email
attributes.description: The email address of the interested person

attributes.name: HasCats
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the interested person has cat(s)

attributes.name: HasDogs
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the interested person has dog(s)

attributes.name: HasOtherPet
attributes.description: Indicates whether or not the interested person has other pet(s)

attributes.name: MaxRent
attributes.description: The max amount the interested person is willing to pay monthly for rent

attributes.name: Messages
attributes.description: Array of objects representing messages sent about a lead

attributes.name: PropertyId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the property associated with the message

attributes.name: UnitId
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the unit associated with the message

attributes.name: Message
attributes.description: The content of the message sent by the lead

attributes.name: Source
attributes.description: The source of the message

attributes.name: Timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time the message was sent, in Coordinated Universal Time (UTC)

attributes.name: MiddleInitial
attributes.description: The middle initial of the interested person

attributes.name: MonthlyIncome
attributes.description: The self-reported monthly income of interested person

attributes.name: PhoneNumber
attributes.description: The phone number of the interested person

attributes.name: Source
attributes.description: The mechanism through which this lead was submitted

attributes.name: Status
attributes.description: Indicates the current phase of engagement with a prospective resident

attributes.name: UnitIds
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the unit(s) that the interested party is interested in

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the created lead. If Duplicate is true, it is the unique identifier of the original lead that was updated.

responseFields.name: Duplicate
responseFields.description: Indicates whether or not the lead is a duplicate of an existing lead. Leads are marked as duplicates if a lead was submitted from a party with the same contact information (phone number or email) that is already associated with a lead with the same PropertyId. If Duplicate is true, the original lead will be updated rather than a new lead being created.

responseFields.name: OriginalLeadId
responseFields.description: ID of the existing lead this lead duplicates. The ID attribute of the newly created lead will be distinct from its duplicate.
